scope: Ontology enums, required record/provenance fields and protocol presence. Populated graph validation is a later gate.
decisions: Preserve committed ontology without rebuilding architecture.
Unknown shape dimensions remain null with reasons.
Similarity strength is separate from consistency classification and epistemic status.
Activity scope and period are mandatory comparison predicates; administrative inventory is not burden evidence.
Freeze requires source-locator validation, deterministic replay, challenge and extraction coverage; enum checks alone are insufficient.
